AWAR D Preface 1.
Detailed Accident Report (DAR) has been filed seeking compensation for death of victim in motor vehicle accident.
Background 2.

As gleaned from DAR read with Final Report under section 279/304A IPC, deceased Shyamveer Singh suffered fatal injuries in a motor vehicle accident near BSES Office, Jaffarpur Kalan, Delhi on 28.01.2022 at 2:15 pm after his bicycle was hit by motorcycle No. DL-3SHU-3333 driven at high speed in rash MACT No.503/2022 Pooja Vs. Surender Singh & Ors..

Injured was shifted to RTRM Hospital,
Jaffarpur Kalan, New Delhi where MLC No.480/22 was prepared and referred to Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi for treatment but could not survive and died on 31.01.2022.
3. FIR No.38/2022 under section 279/337 IPC was registered at PS Jaffarpur Kalan on 28.01.2022 and site-plan was prepared by the IO.

Respondent Surender Singh (driver) produced by Samunder Singh (owner) pursuant to notice under section 133 M.V. Act was formally arrested on 16.04.2022 and released on police bail AND offending motorcycle No.DL-3SHU-3333 and bicycle of victim seized from the spot
were released on superdari after their mechanical inspection.
Documents viz. DL, RC and Policy of offending motorcycle were verified from concerned authorities and dead body of Shyamveer Singh was handed over to its relative after Postmortem Examination.

Offence under section 304A IPC was added on the basis of Postmortem Report No.216/22 and IO thereafter concluded investigation and prepared DAR which was filed in Court along with copy of Final Report under section 279/304A IPC.
Defence 4.

Respondents Surender Singh (driver) and Samunder Singh (owner) have denied (i) involvement and/or (ii) negligence by stating that cyclist fell down and sustained injuries on his own and petitioners are not entitled to claim compensation for his death.

5. Respondent Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Co.
on its part has filed Legal Offer assessing compensation MACT No.503/2022 Pooja Vs. Surender Singh & Ors..

Page No. 4 of 19  Rs.18,05,560/- for death of Shyamveer due to fatal injuries suffered in motor vehicle accident.

opennyai_summary.facts:
Respondent Surender Singh (driver) produced by Samunder Singh (owner) pursuant to notice under section 133 M.V. Act was formally arrested on 16.04.2022 and released on police bail AND offending motorcycle No.DL-3SHU-3333 and bicycle of victim seized from the spot
were released on superdari after their mechanical inspection.
Documents viz. DL, RC and Policy of offending motorcycle were verified from concerned authorities and dead body of Shyamveer Singh was handed over to its relative after Postmortem Examination.
Offence under section 304A IPC was added on the basis of Postmortem Report No.216/22 and IO thereafter concluded investigation and prepared DAR which was filed in Court along with copy of Final Report under section 279/304A IPC.
Respondents Surender Singh (driver) and Samunder Singh (owner) have denied (i) involvement and/or (ii) negligence by stating that cyclist fell down and sustained injuries on his own and petitioners are not entitled to claim compensation for his death.

Accordingly, Rs.18,150/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand One Hundred Fifty only) is awarded to petitioners under the head - 'loss of estate' in terms of aforesaid judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
Similarly, another sum of Rs.18,150/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand One Hundred Fifty only) is awarded to petitioners under the head - 'funeral expenses' in terms of the law/guidelines laid down in aforesaid case.
In view of the law/guidelines laid down in (i) Pranay Sethi (Supra) read with (ii) Magma General Insurance Co. Ltd vs. Nanu Ram (2018) 18 SCC 130 AND (iii) United India Insurance Co. Ltd. vs Satinder Kaur (2021) 11 SCC 780, a sum of Rs.48,400 x 04 = Rs.1,93,600/- (Rupees One Lakh Ninety Three Thousand & Six Hundred only) is awarded to petitioners as compensation under the head 'loss of consortium'.
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the present case, it will be just and proper to grant interest @ 7.5% per annum on the award amount in terms of judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in National Insurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Mannat Johar & Anr. (2019) 15 SCC 260.
Petitioners are therefore awarded interest @ 7.5% per annum upon compensation Rs.23,50,000/- (Rupees Twenty Three Lakhs Fifty Thousand only) from the date of filing of petition on 21.05.2022 till notice of deposit under Order XXI Rule 1 CPC.

R1/Surender Singh (driver) being principal tortfeasor driving Motorcycle No. DL-3SHU-3333 in rash and negligent manner resulting in fatal injuries to Shyamveer Singh and Samunder Singh (owner) being vicariously liable for the act of the driver are liable to pay compensation amount with interest.
However, since Motorcycle No. DL-3SHU-3333 was insured against Third Party Risk so, R3/Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Co. being statutorily liable under Section 149 (1) of M.
